prompt: A classic wooden rocking chair with curved rockers, spindle backrest, a woven rush seat, and a folded plaid blanket draped over one arm. The chair gently rocks back and forth; add a button to start/stop rocking.

A tenkeyless mechanical keyboard with an aluminum case, sculpted keycaps in two tones (off-white alphas, grey modifiers), a coiled USB cable, and subtle per-key RGB backlight glow. Keys depress when the user types on their real keyboard.

A small log cabin in a clearing: stacked round logs with overlapping corners, a stone chimney emitting a thin smoke trail, a covered front porch with a bench, windows glowing warm, a woodpile, and a few pine trees around it. Snow on the roof.

A single maple tree in autumn: a thick branching trunk generated recursively, a dense canopy of orange-red-yellow leaf clusters, and individual leaves slowly falling and accumulating on the grass below.

A Newton's cradle desk toy: a chrome frame on a black base, five steel balls hung by thin wires in V pairs. Simulate the classic motion: pull back one ball (or click to choose 1–3 balls) and momentum transfers through the row realistically.

A freshly baked pizza on a wooden peel: slightly irregular crust with browned edges, tomato sauce, melted cheese with bubbles, pepperoni slices, basil leaves, and one slice partially pulled away with a stretchy cheese strand.

A university library reading room about 15 m x 10 m: tall bookshelves along the walls densely filled with books, long wooden tables with green banker's lamps, chairs, a circulation desk, a hanging directional sign, and large windows. Camera at 1.6 m eye height from the doorway.

An original snail courier character (not based on any existing IP): a friendly snail with a spiral shell that has a tiny mailbag strapped on, a cap, big eyes on eyestalks, sliding slowly forward and leaving a faint shiny trail.
